backends.name: foam3 (embedded)
backends.notes: FOAM NoteService over box RPC. embedded: in-memory MDAO + FOAM journal file; postgres: FOAM's PostgresDAO (JDBC). Both via EasyDAO with SequenceNumberDAO ids.

implementation.server: FOAM3 Jetty HttpServer with NanoRouter at /service/*
implementation.concurrency: Jetty thread pool (FOAM defaults), ZGC, heap 75% of container
implementation.db_access: embedded: in-memory MDAO + journal file; postgres: FOAM PostgresDAO (JDBC)
